watertemple.title: Hello, water
watertemple.summary: Domain-warped noise. Exists to exercise the foundation end to end.

watertemple.title: Depth absorption
watertemple.summary: Beer-Lambert tint and scattering fog by water depth: a sloping basin with a drop-off and submerged objects, shown through colour alone.

watertemple.title: Detail normals
watertemple.summary: Two or three scrolling layers of a baked, tileable ripple normal map, blended five ways so the classic flattening is visible.

watertemple.title: Flow maps
watertemple.summary: A top-down river: a baked flow field steers two cross-faded phases of a ripple normal map around the rocks.

watertemple.title: Fresnel and sky reflection
watertemple.summary: Open water reflecting a procedural sky, weighted by Schlick Fresnel over a deep-water body colour. Proves fresnel.wgsl, sky.wgsl and the cubemap helper.

watertemple.title: HDR bloom and tonemapping
watertemple.summary: Dark water with sun glints, lantern reflections and caustic lines whose radiance runs far above 1, rendered into rgba16float, bloomed and tonemapped. Proves the post chain and the opt-in HDR canvas.

watertemple.title: Reflection strategies
watertemple.summary: Planar reflection against screen-space reflection on a calm pool, side by side: what each costs and where each one breaks.

watertemple.title: Screen-space refraction
watertemple.summary: Looks through animated water at a backdrop texture: a normal-driven uv offset (Snell or the cheap form), chromatic dispersion, mip blur and safe edges.

watertemple.title: Shore foam and edge fade
watertemple.summary: Top-down beach: waves lap in and out, foam dissolves along the waterline and around rocks, and the water fades in softly where it meets the sand.

watertemple.title: Sun glint and sparkle
watertemple.summary: A low sun over open water: a tight GGX sun lobe plus hashed-cell glitter that twinkles with the waves and stays stable under camera motion. Proves specular.wgsl.

watertemple.title: Wave-crest subsurface scattering
watertemple.summary: Big, backlit waves where the tall, thin crests glow green-blue as the sun shines through them. One view- and light-dependent term; proves sss.wgsl.

watertemple.title: Ink wash background
watertemple.summary: A very slow watercolour field: soft blooms of pigment with darker pooled edges, granulation and paper fibres, rendered at a quarter of the resolution and upsampled.

watertemple.title: Layered wave divider
watertemple.summary: Two to five layers of wave silhouettes with scroll parallax and a foam line, transparent above and filled with the next section’s colour below.

watertemple.title: Mist and steam layer
watertemple.summary: A translucent overlay of drifting mist or rising steam in three depth layers that shift at different rates as the page scrolls, with a hard cap on its opacity.

watertemple.title: Pool floor
watertemple.summary: A swimming pool seen from above: tiles refracted through moving water, lit by caustics, tinted by depth. Every optics chunk in one cheap pass.

watertemple.title: Procedural caustics
watertemple.summary: The light pattern at the bottom of a pool as a transparent, tileable overlay. Two procedural constructions (warped Voronoi and iterated sine) and a baked one- or two-tap version, compared on cost and look.

watertemple.title: Puddles and wet surfaces
watertemple.summary: Rain-soaked ground seen at an angle: puddles fill the low spots and mirror a dusk city through rain ripple rings, and the damp stone around them is darker and glossier.

watertemple.title: Rain on glass
watertemple.summary: A rainy window at night: every drop is a tiny lens showing a sharp, flipped piece of the street while the misted glass around it is out of focus, and running drops wipe clean trails.

watertemple.title: Toon water
watertemple.summary: Cel-shaded water in one cheap pass: flat depth bands, crisp animated cell-noise foam, a breathing shore ring, ink outlines and hard-edged glints around a little island.

watertemple.title: Underwater ambience
watertemple.summary: Looking up from below the surface: slow light shafts, drifting marine snow in two layers, depth fog and a gentle wobble, with an optional caustic seabed. Calm enough to put text over.

watertemple.title: Water over image or video
watertemple.summary: Looks at a picture or a video through moving water: baked-normal refraction, a light highlight, optional colour fringing, safe edges and a ripple under the pointer. Drop your own file on it.

watertemple.title: 3D pool
watertemple.summary: A pool in perspective with an orbiting camera, a ball you can drag through the water, ripples that make real caustics on the floor and walls, and refraction and reflection ray-traced against the pool box and the ball.

watertemple.title: Interactive ripples
watertemple.summary: The classic touch-the-water surface: a 2D wave equation on the GPU, stirred by mouse, pen and fingers, falling rain and a faint idle swell, refracting a backdrop. Runs as render passes or compute passes, same maths.

watertemple.title: Ripple caustics
watertemple.summary: Real caustics computed from the live ripple surface: a drop sends a ring of focused light sweeping across a tiled pool floor. Two methods (a projected light mesh and a per-pixel Jacobian estimate) and a side-by-side against the procedural fake.

watertemple.title: Ripples around page elements
watertemple.summary: Water behind a real page where the page itself is solid: elements marked data-wt-obstacle are measured every frame and become walls of the wave solver, so ripples bend around a card, bounce off a headline and are pushed by a card that moves.

watertemple.title: Ripples driven by scroll and sound
watertemple.summary: A heightfield surface that answers the page instead of the pointer: scrolling feeds waves in from the leading edge and sloshes on a hard stop, and a built-in synthesised beat (or a dropped audio or video file) turns bass into broad swells, mids and highs into fine rain and onsets into drops. Silent and calm until the first click.

watertemple.title: Aurora ribbons
watertemple.summary: Slow emerald, cyan and violet ribbons flowing around page elements, with fine luminous folds and soft rising curtains. A separate variation of ink orbit using the same obstacle-aware fluid simulation.

watertemple.title: Bioluminescent currents
watertemple.summary: Cyan and green organisms flash on sharp turns or pointer proximity, leaving delicate wakes.

watertemple.title: Dichroic glass
watertemple.summary: Refractive teal and magenta ribbons with thin-film colour, crisp highlights and overlapping depth.

watertemple.title: Eclipse halos
watertemple.summary: Narrow moving rings around page outlines, with quiet fluid arcs escaping into the dark.

watertemple.title: Fluid-pushed image and type
watertemple.summary: Drag across a picture, a video or a headline and the content is pushed around by a real incompressible fluid: it smears and swirls like wet paint, then springs back at a rate you choose. A displacement field is carried by the flow of the stable-fluids solver and the content is sampled through it.

watertemple.title: Game of Life
watertemple.summary: Conway’s B3/S23 automaton, with luminous cells and fading echoes behind a real page.

watertemple.title: Ink in a stable fluid
watertemple.summary: Drag to push a real incompressible fluid and paint dye that curls into vortices and fades. A stable-fluids solver in compute shaders (advection, pressure projection, vorticity confinement, MacCormack or BFECC), a coarse velocity grid carrying a fine dye grid.

watertemple.title: Ink in a tank (3D fluid)
watertemple.summary: A drop of ink released in a glass tank of water sinks, rolls up into a vortex ring and breaks into tendrils. A volumetric stable-fluids solve (48 to 96 cells, multigrid pressure, vorticity confinement, MacCormack ink) in compute shaders, drawn by a ray march with coloured absorption and a precomputed light volume. Tap to release a drop, drag to push the water, drag the background to orbit.

watertemple.title: Ink in water and on paper
watertemple.summary: Paint pigment into a stable-fluids solver and watch it bloom, feather along the paper fibres, pool darker at the edge of a wash and dry. Diffusion, a deposited layer that stays when the water stops, wetness, granulation and subtractive colour on top of the dye solver.

watertemple.title: Ink orbiting page elements
watertemple.summary: Luminous RGB trails in a stable fluid on a dark background, with heads smoothly cycling through red, green and blue together while their tails keep the colours they were laid with. Drawn into loose orbits round the page: elements marked data-wt-obstacle are measured every frame and become solid, and the heads of the trails are pulled to each outline and swung round it, never quite settling. Drag a card and the trails follow. On an HDR display the glow is brighter than SDR white.

watertemple.title: Liquid chrome
watertemple.summary: Black and silver fluid ribbons reflecting moving studio lights with tiny spectral glints.

watertemple.title: Neon calligraphy
watertemple.summary: Glowing ink blots, tapering luminous lines and faint afterimages.

watertemple.title: Neon mycelium
watertemple.summary: Self-organizing neon networks grow around the page’s headings and cards.

watertemple.title: Shallow water: dam break and flow
watertemple.summary: Water that actually flows: a shallow-water solver on the GPU moves a depth and a velocity over terrain. A dam breaks and the surge rushes around pillars, a spring runs down a hillside into a lake, a tide fills and drains rock pools. Pour water, push it, dig channels.

watertemple.title: Silk embers
watertemple.summary: Copper, crimson and gold filaments that cool as detached sparks drift upward.

watertemple.title: Wind tunnel: flow round obstacles
watertemple.summary: A steady wind carries rows of dye past solid shapes drawn from signed distance fields, or past the real cards and headline of the page. The stable-fluids solver makes the flow go round them: a bluff body sheds an alternating vortex street. Drag a shape to push the water, stir where there is none.

watertemple.title: 2D position-based fluids
watertemple.summary: A tank of water as particles solved with position-based fluids (Macklin and Mueller): incompressibility is a constraint on positions, relaxed by a few parallel iterations per sub-step, so a big time step cannot blow the water up. A dam break that collapses and sloshes, a stream pouring onto a shelf, a wave-maker, drops falling into a calm pool. Drag to push the water, tap to drop a blob. Colour the particles by speed, by density error (how well the constraint holds) or by neighbour count; change the particle spacing and the same parameters give the same water.

watertemple.title: 2D SPH liquid
watertemple.summary: A tank of water as thousands of particles: weakly compressible smoothed-particle hydrodynamics in compute shaders, drawn as one liquid body (soft blobs, a threshold, a rim, a highlight, refraction) instead of discs. A dam break that collapses and sloshes back, a stream pouring onto a shelf and an obstacle, two zero-gravity blobs that merge under surface tension. Drag to push the water, tap to drop a block of it.

watertemple.title: MLS-MPM water tank
watertemple.summary: A tank of water simulated with the moving-least-squares material point method: 100 000 particles carry the fluid, a background grid does the physics, and there is no neighbour search. A wall pushes in and out and sends waves down the tank to break on a beach; or let a dam burst around pillars, or pour a stream into a pool. Drag through the water to push it, tap to drop a blob, drag empty space to orbit. Drawn as a refracting liquid by the screen-space fluid surface, or as the spheres, speed or density it is made of.

watertemple.title: Particle field and neighbour grid
watertemple.summary: A fountain of up to a million spray particles carried by a curl-noise flow, drawn as instanced billboards. The foundation of the particle fluids: a GPU particle system, a fixed-step integrator, and a uniform-grid neighbour search built by a counting sort and prefix sum every frame. Colour the cloud by its neighbour counts, or light up the neighbours of the particle under the pointer, to see the search at work. Move the pointer to aim the nozzle, drag to orbit.

watertemple.title: Position-based fluid tank (3D)
watertemple.summary: Water as ten thousand particles by default in a glass tank, solved with position-based fluids (Macklin and Mueller 2013) on the GPU and drawn as a refracting liquid surface. Three restartable scenes: a dam break with two pillars, a pour that fills the tank, and a wave tank with an oscillating wall. Drag empty space to orbit, drag through the water to push it, tap to drop a blob. Secondary spray, foam and bubbles follow the live water. Choose container mode to drag or shake the vessel, or enable device tilt. The particle count, solver iterations and sub-steps, viscosity, vorticity and the renderer quality are live.

watertemple.title: Screen-space fluid surface
watertemple.summary: A cloud of particles turned into a continuous, refracting liquid: sphere impostors, depth smoothing (bilateral against narrow-range), thickness, normals and a composite with absorption, reflection and a sun highlight. Three synthetic sources (a ball that splits and merges, a wave, a pouring stream) stand in for a solver; one control swaps between the finished surface, the bag of marbles it replaces and each intermediate image.

watertemple.title: Across the waterline
watertemple.summary: A moving wave meniscus separates air and water with underwater tint and attenuation.

watertemple.title: Breaking shoreline
watertemple.summary: Shoaling wave crests wash across a sloping beach with depth foam and reflective wet sand.

watertemple.title: Calm lake
watertemple.summary: A mirrored camera pass reflects distant ridges and trees through light wind ripples.

watertemple.title: Gerstner ocean
watertemple.summary: Six analytic waves, projected and clipmap meshes, and floating buoys with CPU or GPU sampling.

watertemple.title: River current
watertemple.summary: A signed flow map diverts two-phase water detail around rocks and trails foam downstream.

watertemple.title: Spectral ocean
watertemple.summary: Three band-limited Phillips cascades, compute inverse FFT and persistent folding foam.

watertemple.title: Waterfall and mist
watertemple.summary: Scrolling water sheets, a foamy plunge pool and bounded GPU particle spray.

watertemple.title: Droplets on UI
watertemple.summary: Condensation droplets grow, coalesce with conserved volume, and slide down a card under gravity.

watertemple.title: Fill-level components
watertemple.summary: A tank, progress bar and round loader share a sloshing liquid level.

watertemple.title: Gooey metaballs
watertemple.summary: Smooth SDF unions join navigation pills to an animated or pointer-driven liquid follower.

watertemple.title: Liquid buttons
watertemple.summary: Hover or focus to stretch a spring-driven button; press it to launch a surface ripple.

watertemple.title: Liquid glass panels
watertemple.summary: Rounded glass lenses refract a designed backdrop with blur, colour dispersion and a specular rim.

watertemple.title: Liquid image hover
watertemple.summary: Move across a coastal image to bend it with ripples and a subtle colour split.

watertemple.title: Liquid transitions
watertemple.summary: Drip wipes, wave reveals and displacement dissolves switch between two designed sections.

watertemple.title: Liquid typography
watertemple.summary: An Anton MSDF atlas keeps liquid lettering sharp as it ripples, melts and fills with water.

watertemple.title: Ray-marched liquid blob
watertemple.summary: A three-dimensional smooth metaball lens refracts the environment through an exit surface.

watertemple.title: Scroll-linked water level
watertemple.summary: The backdrop submerges with page or nested-container scrolling.

watertemple.title: Water cursor trail
watertemple.summary: Pointer movement leaves a persistent wet streak that spreads and dries.

watertemple.title: Bubbles
watertemple.summary: Rising, wobbling underwater lenses and iridescent soap-film bubbles.

watertemple.title: Fogged glass
watertemple.summary: Persistent condensation can be wiped with a pointer and slowly refogs.

watertemple.title: Frost and melt
watertemple.summary: Dendritic ice spreads over glass, thaws into refracting beads and drains downward.

watertemple.title: Rain ripple rings
watertemple.summary: Expanding wave rings refract a tiled water surface after procedural rain impacts.

watertemple.title: Rain streaks and splashes
watertemple.summary: Depth-layered instanced rain, wind, ground rings and ballistic splash droplets.

watertemple.title: Splash burst
watertemple.summary: Bounded ballistic droplet bursts on click or tap, with optional ambient fountains.

firetemple.title: Hello, fire
firetemple.summary: Rising warped noise through the HDR tail. Exists to exercise the foundation end to end.

firetemple.title: Advected noise
firetemple.summary: Ways to make noise look carried by rising gas instead of sliding past as one texture, side by side on the same heat field: scroll, domain warp, flow noise, curl displacement, a two-phase flow blend, and the combination that measures best.

firetemple.title: Blackbody colour
firetemple.summary: Temperature to colour three ways (Planck integral, polynomial fit, lookup texture) with their error, and a brightness mapping tamed enough to use.

firetemple.title: Bloom tuned for fire
firetemple.summary: A chart of hot shapes at known radiance, to find how little bloom still reads as heat: threshold, knee, radius, levels, and half against full resolution.

firetemple.title: Compositing over the page
firetemple.summary: One flame, smoke and logs written to a see-through canvas five ways: what an overlay effect has to put in alpha to read on a dark page and a light one.

firetemple.title: Fire as a light source
firetemple.summary: Wandering flames light a stone page and the cards on it: windowed inverse-square falloff, normal-mapped relief and analytic soft shadows from rounded rectangles.

firetemple.title: Flame colour ramps
firetemple.summary: One flame through eight colour ramps: blackbody, an authored fire gradient, a banded toon ramp, a blue gas flame and four chemical tints, each as a formula and as a baked texture.

firetemple.title: Flame shaping
firetemple.summary: One flame at three stages: a teardrop or taper distance field, the heat left after turbulence and erosion, and that heat through the fire ramp.

firetemple.title: Flicker signals
firetemple.summary: The shared flicker signal driving three candles, with a scrolling trace of each against the 10% band that defines a flash. Capped by default; the uncapped path is an explicit switch.

firetemple.title: Heat haze
firetemple.summary: Rising hot air bends what is behind it: a noise-driven refraction of a backdrop texture, masked by heat, with a faint colour fringe and softening where it is hottest.

firetemple.title: Smoke shading
firetemple.summary: A ray-marched smoke plume lit from below by its fire and from above by a dim sky, comparing three ways to self-shadow it.

firetemple.title: Soft additive sprites
firetemple.summary: Embers, sparks and glow puffs as instanced additive quads: procedural shapes, velocity stretch, and the soft-particle depth fade that hides where a sprite cuts through geometry.

firetemple.title: Volume ray-march kernel
firetemple.summary: An emissive flame and absorbing smoke integrated in one ray march, at reduced resolution, upsampled under the depth buffer so edges against geometry stay sharp.

firetemple.title: Candle flame
firetemple.summary: One candle on the page: a teardrop flame with a blue foot, a dark wick and a soft halo over a wax body. It sways on its own and leans away from the pointer.

firetemple.title: Ember bed
firetemple.summary: A bed of glowing coals: dark crusts, cracks that breathe, and heat drifting slowly across it. The coal layout is baked once, so a frame is three texture fetches.

firetemple.title: Fire ring
firetemple.summary: A flame bent round a circle: tongues lick outward or inward from a ring, seamless all the way round, with a progress value that lights only part of it. Transparent in the middle.

firetemple.title: Firelight background
firetemple.summary: The warm, slowly shifting light of a fire that is just out of frame. No flames: an opaque, calm backdrop for a dark page, steady enough to sit behind text.

firetemple.title: Fireplace
firetemple.summary: A whole hearth in one fragment pass: three layers of flame behind charred logs with glowing undersides, firelight on the wall and floor, and embers rising, with no simulation state.

firetemple.title: Flame strip
firetemple.summary: A band of flame tongues along the bottom edge of a wide, short canvas. It repeats exactly once per canvas width, so it tiles at any width, and is see-through above the flames.

firetemple.title: Gas jet
firetemple.summary: A blue directional flame: a tight cone with a pale inner cone, alone, in a row or as a stove burner seen from above, and with shock diamonds along it for an exhaust.

firetemple.title: Heat-haze overlay
firetemple.summary: Hot air on its own: an image or a video shimmering in a band, a plume or all over, with no flame in sight. Drop a photo or a video file on it to try your own.

firetemple.title: Scrolling-noise flame
firetemple.summary: The classic: noise scrolled upward, shaped by a height gradient, through a fire ramp. A wall of flame along the bottom edge, with five noise sources to compare.

firetemple.title: Stateless sparks
firetemple.summary: Sparks that rise, wobble, cool and die with no buffers and no particle state: each pixel finds its spark from two hashes, in a few depth layers.

firetemple.title: Toon fire
firetemple.summary: Cartoon fire: three or four flat bands of colour with hard edges and an ink outline, redrawn ten times a second like a hand-animated cel. Opaque paint, so it sits on a light page.

firetemple.title: Torch and brazier
firetemple.summary: Up to 48 small flames in one canvas, each on a torch or in a brazier and each with its own seed, in a loop that closes exactly. Built to find out what many small flames cost.

lighttemple.title: Pointer Light
lighttemple.summary: A cursor-following area light casting soft, finite shadows from extruded 2D shapes.

lighttemple.title: Sun & Soft Shadows
lighttemple.summary: Directional shadow mapping with hard, PCF, Poisson and contact-hardening PCSS filters side by side.

lighttemple.title: Studio Lighting
lighttemple.summary: A glTF product shot lit only by its environment, with a soft shadow catcher that melts into the page.

lighttemple.title: Embossed Card
lighttemple.summary: A letterpress, embossed or foil-stamped business card on paper, steel or leather, raked by your cursor.

lighttemple.title: Holographic Card
lighttemple.summary: A foil trading card that tilts toward your cursor (or phone): diffraction rainbows, thin-film colour and brushed highlights.

lighttemple.title: Glass Panels
lighttemple.summary: Draggable frosted-glass UI cards: refraction at the bevels, real blur, colour fringing and rim light from your cursor.

lighttemple.title: Radiance Cascades
lighttemple.summary: Paint lights and walls and watch real-time 2D global illumination: soft shadows, colour bleeding and light leaking through gaps.

lighttemple.title: Long Shadows
lighttemple.summary: Flat-design long shadows for icons and type, cast in real time from your cursor using SDF sweeps.

lighttemple.title: Neon Sign
lighttemple.summary: A flickering neon sign from any text: glass tubes, white-hot cores and coloured light spilling across brick.

lighttemple.title: Lit Typography
lighttemple.summary: A real, editable HTML heading rendered as lit 3D extruded letters, with per-letter metals and shadows from your cursor.
